en: I turn over the man to my liege for punishment, as he has broken the law of the land and it is my sworn duty to enforce it.

Leather skins? Yes, I just received some information on that. It would appear that of $2067w heavy leather needed, the Horde has collected $2066w. Also, $2070w out of $2071w thick leather and $2073w out of $2074w rugged leather have been gathered.
I cannot teach you elemental leatherworking, $n. You must go to Tanaris and find the home of Narain Soothfancy. Once there, consult the book "Soothsaying for Dummies."
Elder Stonefort has taken to the dungeons of Blackrock Spire.

The Creators are cognizant of the magnitude of the information housed in this repository.  Subsequently, a portable copy of the data stored here will be made available to you once you are attuned with the Discs of Norgannon.$B$BPlease consider your cursory requirements for the assimilation of this knowledge to be complete.  At your leisure, access the Discs of Norgannon to begin synthesis of your discs.
Only flesh and bone. Mortals are such easy prey...
Not all Forsaken are driven by Sylvanas' will, $n. Some of us are driven by true power--power we earn for ourselves.
You dare defile this holy ground?
An Ash'ari Crystal has fallen! Stay true to the Lich King, my brethren, and attempt to resummon it.
As to your warning - worry not. Our troops are all aware of the chain of command. We fight united. Let us hope your own troops remember that...
Darrowshire is defeated!  Soon, all of Lordaeron will fall!

Hello, $c. I trust that you bring good tidings concerning the Ahn'Qiraj War preparations. I myself have been placed in charge of all accumulation of rugged leather for the Horde; a task to which I feel uniquely qualified. Never underestimate the utility of a sharpened knife.$B$BAs to the rugged leather, we currently have $2073w out of $2074w needed.
Question 1, Chain 2
How can I get anything done with the Scourge running amok around here?!
I think I hear him coming!  Look to the west!

Woo Ping's stamina is simply astounding.  Watching him practice his weapon techniques for hours on end, I felt sorry for the practice dummy afterward.  I can't think of anyone better suited to train you in armed combat.
I am here!  Now, puny little worms, you will pay for your intrusion!
The battle for Alterac Valley has begun!
You, soldier, report back to Kargath at once!
I'll feed your souls to Hakkar himself!
A wild-looking contraption stands before you with a simple plaque heralding the name of the device: "The Sparklematic 5200".  The machine seems to be designed to make items shiny and new again.
Then it is to Taim Ragetotem that you must speak. Seek him out on the Hunter Rise.
Like Kel'Thuzad, I too was once a mage of the Kirin Tor. And like Kel'Thuzad, I seek the legendary Atiesh, greatstaff of the Guardian. Our fates are intertwined as such, $c.
Hey Jangdor - can you teach me how to make Wild Leather Boots again?
Maybe... What do I do now?
We didn't hide this stuff just you could steal it!
Ah.  Welcome $gsir:my lady;!

We of the Horde have done all that we can to prepare for the upcoming war at Ahn'Qiraj. Now we wait, $c, for the Alliance to do the same. Once they are done we will all transport our war materiel to Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
Eranikus, Tyrant of the Dream, is wholly consumed by the Light of Elune. Tranquility sets in over the Moonglade.
I am absolutely certain that I want to learn dragonscale leatherworking.
Get to your posts! Let no invader reach Southshore!

There is no finer cook in Thunder Bluff than Aska Mistrunner.  Mmmmm, I can smell what she is cooking from here.  Head over to her kitchen located on the high rise.

Drat... now I am hungry.
Now this is an example of what not to summon. Look, it's frail and brittle. One good whack from a mace will send bone shards flying.
Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian. The staff handed down through the ages to each of the Guardians of Tirisfal. The staff corrupted by Sargeras. The staff of the last Guardian. The staff of Medivh.
The stable is empty! We must provide our cavalry with suitable mounts. Stormpike Stables requests your assistance!
No part of the animals we hunt is wasted.
I don't get paid enough for this!
No... more... Feugen.
%s begins casting a counterspell...
